source: I can pick you up after work, but I cannot stay for dinner.
meaning: Pickup after work; dinner refusal; negation.

source: That repair cost an arm and a leg. I am pretty broke now.
meaning: Very expensive repair; little money; not literal limbs.

source: Let's call it a day and finish the fence tomorrow.
meaning: Stop work today; finish fence tomorrow.

source: Do not start the engine until I remove the jumper cables.
meaning: Prohibition until cables removed; safety condition.

source: The total is 127 dollars and 50 cents, not 175 dollars.
meaning: 127.50 dollars; reject 175.

source: The delivery is on October 12 at 3:30 in the afternoon.
meaning: October 12; 15:30; delivery.

source: Cut two boards, each 45 inches long, and leave a quarter-inch gap.
meaning: Two boards; 45 inches each; gap 0.25 inch.

source: The truck cranks but won't start, and the check-engine light is on.
meaning: Starter turns; engine will not run; warning lamp.

source: The brake pedal feels soft after we replaced the master cylinder.
meaning: Spongy brake pedal; master cylinder replacement.

source: Shut off the breaker before you replace that outlet.
meaning: Disconnect circuit breaker before electrical outlet work.

source: The concrete needs to cure before we remove the forms.
meaning: Concrete curing; remove formwork later.

source: Move the calves to the north pasture and check the water trough.
meaning: Young cattle; north pasture; drinking trough inspection.

source: The irrigation pump lost its prime, so the field is not getting water.
meaning: Pump priming lost; field not irrigated.

source: If the hose is still leaking, maybe just... wait, close the valve first.
meaning: Interrupted plan; close valve first; hose leak condition.

source: Put the jack next to the tire, not by the river bank.
meaning: Vehicle lifting jack; tire; river bank negated.

source: I didn't say he stole the tools; I said nobody saw him return them.
meaning: No accusation of theft; nobody witnessed return.

source: Te puedo llevar después del trabajo, pero hoy no me puedo quedar a cenar.
meaning: Ride after work; cannot stay for dinner today.

source: Ahorita no traigo feria; te pago el viernes.
meaning: Casual Mexican Spanish: no cash now; payment Friday.

source: Me estás tomando el pelo o de verdad se descompuso otra vez?
meaning: Are you teasing me; did it actually break again?

source: No prendas el motor hasta que quite los cables para pasar corriente.
meaning: Do not start until jumper cables removed.

source: Son ciento veintisiete dólares con cincuenta centavos, no ciento setenta y cinco.
meaning: 127.50 dollars; not 175.

source: La entrega es el doce de octubre a las tres y media de la tarde.
meaning: October 12; 15:30; delivery.

source: Necesito tres litros de aceite y una manguera de dos metros.
meaning: Three liters oil; two-meter hose.

source: La camioneta da marcha, pero no arranca y está prendida la luz del motor.
meaning: Starter cranks; no engine start; engine warning lamp.

source: El pedal del freno se siente esponjoso desde que cambiamos la bomba de freno.
meaning: Spongy brake pedal; master cylinder replaced.

source: Baja el interruptor antes de cambiar ese contacto.
meaning: Circuit off before electrical outlet replacement; regional contacto.

source: Hay que dejar curar el concreto antes de quitar la cimbra.
meaning: Concrete cure first; regional formwork cimbra.

source: Lleva los becerros al potrero del norte y revisa el bebedero.
meaning: Calves; north pasture; water trough.

source: La bomba de riego perdió el cebado y no está llegando agua al cultivo.
meaning: Lost pump prime; crop not receiving water.

source: Si todavía gotea la manguera, mejor... no, espera, cierra primero la válvula.
meaning: Interrupted suggestion; first close valve; leaking hose.

source: Deja el gato junto a la llanta; estoy hablando de la herramienta, no del animal.
meaning: Vehicle jack, not cat; next to tire.

source: No dije que se robó las herramientas; dije que nadie lo vio devolverlas.
meaning: No theft accusation; return not witnessed.
